meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加一个本地监控仪表盘,展示 agent 分组、会话、渠道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志;Claude 会安装 npm 包、复制 pusher 模块并接入 src/index.ts。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘时触发(如 /add-dashboard);装好后仪表盘随服务启动,未设 DASHBOARD_SECRET 时不启动。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上监控仪表盘
say.note: 安装仪表盘包并接入 pusher

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and live logs. Claude installs the package, copies the pusher, and wires it into src/index.ts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw, e.g. /add-dashboard.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Installs the package and wires in the pusher

say_en.text: Remove the dashboard you just added
